mapper.select: SELECT ID,task_id,task_thread_desc,task_thread_cron,tesk_thread_sort FROM system_docking.api_task_thread_ins WHERE task_id=#{processId} AND is_enable='1' ORDER BY tesk_thread_sort
SELECT ID,system_id,platfrom_code,platfrom_name,platform_desc FROM system_docking.api_interface_system_platform_info WHERE system_id=#{systemId} AND is_enable='1'
SELECT ID,platform_id,index_code,index_name,index_desc FROM system_docking.api_platform_index_info WHERE platform_id=#{platformId} AND is_enable='1'
SELECT ID,platform_id,resource_code,resource_mac,resource_desc FROM system_docking.api_system_resource WHERE platform_id=#{platformId} AND is_enable='1'
SELECT ID,resource_id,ip_address FROM system_docking.api_system_resource_ip WHERE resource_id=#{resourceId} AND is_enable='1'
SELECT * FROM ${params.dataBase}.api_system_records WHERE api_status <> '200' AND api_count < ${params.restartCount}

update.foreach: UPDATE ${params.dataBase}.api_system_records SET api_status=#{item.statusCode}, add_time=#{item.addTime}, api_count=(api_count + #{item.restartCount}) WHERE ID=#{item.ID}

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM information_schema.TABLES t WHERE t.TABLE_SCHEMA =#{params.dataBase} and t.TABLE_NAME =#{params.tableName}

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ${params.dataBase}.${params.tableName} ( `ID` varchar(32) COLLATE utf8_bin COLLATE utf8_bin NOT NULL COMMENT '主键', `system_id` varchar(32) COLLATE utf8_bin DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '系统ID', `platform_id` varchar(32) COLLATE utf8_bin DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '平台ID', `index_id` varchar(32) COLLATE utf8_bin DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '指标ID', `resource_id` varchar(32) COLLATE utf8_bin DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '资源ID', `resource_code` varchar(500) COLLATE utf8_bin DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '资源code', `resource_ip` varchar(32) COLLATE utf8_bin DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '资源IP', `time` varchar(32) COLLATE utf8_bin DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '时间', `content` text COLLATE utf8_bin DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '内容', `ADD_DATE` varchar(20) COLLATE utf8_bin DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '新增时间', INDEX(`system_id`),INDEX(`platform_id`),INDEX(`index_id`),INDEX(`time`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8 COLLATE=utf8_bin ROW_FORMAT=DYNAMIC COMMENT='${params.tableDesc}';

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS upm.netperformanceeventlog_${params.tableMonth} ( `id` varchar(32) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_bin NOT NULL, `category` varchar(100) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_bin NULL COMMENT '分类', `name` varchar(500) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_bin NULL COMMENT '名称', `lineId` varchar(100) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_bin NULL COMMENT '链路Id', `netsegmentId1` varchar(20) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_bin NULL COMMENT '网段1', `netsegmentId2` varchar(20) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_bin NULL COMMENT '网段2', `level` varchar(10) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_bin NULL COMMENT '警报等级', `time` varchar(32) COLLATE utf8_bin DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '告警时间', `triggerCondition` text CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_bin NULL COMMENT '触发条件', `probeId` varchar(40) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_bin NULL COMMENT '探针', `ADD_DATE` varchar(20) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_bin NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '新增时间', PRIMARY KEY (`id`),INDEX(`name`),INDEX(`lineId`),INDEX(`level`),INDEX(`probeId`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8 COLLATE=utf8_bin ROW_FORMAT=DYNAMIC COMMENT='网络/SDN性能警报日志';

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS upm.alarmlogAbnormalbehavior_${params.tableMonth} ( `id` varchar(32) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_bin NOT NULL, `category` varchar(100) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_bin NULL COMMENT '分类', `name` varchar(500) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_bin NULL COMMENT '名称', `clientIpAddr` varchar(20) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_bin NULL COMMENT '客户端', `clientPort` varchar(10) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_bin NULL COMMENT '客户端端口', `clientNetsegmentId` varchar(20) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_bin NULL COMMENT '客户器网段', `serverIpAddr` varchar(20) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_bin NULL COMMENT '服务器', `serverPort` varchar(10) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_bin NULL COMMENT '服务器端口', `serverNetsegmentId` varchar(20) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_bin NULL COMMENT '服务器网段', `ipAddr` varchar(20) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_bin NULL COMMENT 'IP地址', `netsegmentId` varchar(20) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_bin NULL COMMENT '网段', `level` varchar(10) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_bin NULL COMMENT '警报等级', `time` varchar(32) COLLATE utf8_bin DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '告警时间', `triggerCondition` text CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_bin NULL COMMENT '触发条件', `probeId` varchar(40) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_bin NULL COMMENT '探针', `ADD_DATE` varchar(20) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_bin NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '新增时间', PRIMARY KEY (`id`),INDEX(`category`),INDEX(`clientIpAddr`), INDEX(`serverIpAddr`),INDEX(`ipAddr`),INDEX(`level`),INDEX(`probeId`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8 COLLATE=utf8_bin ROW_FORMAT=DYNAMIC COMMENT='异常行为日志表';
